svg.title: Finding 6: Judges rank students by quality, not by lineage
svg.desc: Capable judges agree on how to rank five students (τ = 0.96) and the ranking is the students' own solver accuracy (τ = 0.98); at B = 10 the lineage effect on false accepts is +0.010 for Qwen3, −0.075 for Llama and +0.010 for Qwen2.5.
svg.text: with the students' own solver accuracy; at
B = 10 no family favors its own lineage

g.text: one line per judge (B = 8,192); students by solver accuracy

svg.text: Judges rank students by quality, not by lineage
